description: HTTP/2 stream multiplexing behavior at 32 concurrent streams per connection. H1 is not applicable. Primary driver: h2load (-c 1 -m 32). k6 secondary driver simulates concurrency via VUs, NOT true stream multiplexing — use h2load results for multiplexing claims.
loopback_caveat: Results are not equivalent to network-path benchmarks. transport_mode=loopback-h2c is mandatory in all result artifacts.

concurrency.note: h2load: 1 connection, 32 streams (true multiplexing). k6: 32 VUs sharing connections (NOT equivalent).

key_metrics: http_req_duration p50, p99 — latency tail under stream contention
HOL-blocking signals — latency variance across concurrent streams

h3.reason: H3/QUIC stream multiplexing requires confirmed QUIC driver. H3 eliminates H2 HOL-blocking at transport layer — primary comparison value pending toolchain.

h1.reason: H1 does not support stream multiplexing. This scenario is H2/H3 only by definition.

driver_equivalence_note: h2load and k6 are NOT equivalent for this scenario. h2load -c 1 -m 32 measures true single-connection stream multiplexing. k6 with 32 VUs measures multi-connection concurrent load. Claims must specify driver. Do not mix results.

community_h2c_h2load_v1.note: Authoritative contract for stream-multiplexing claims. k6 results are supplementary only.

comparison_axis_note: H2 vs H3 multiplexing comparison will require H3 toolchain. Do not conflate stream count with connection count in result labels.
